Flank, rounded shoulder, polished bezel rising inward to the crystal seat, inner lip

lug.note: one lug, mirrored to all four: tip, inner edge and outer offset by depth below the tip from the trace (mean of the four photo lugs); top slopes down to the tip

rehaut.note: polished ring from the dial edge (16.85 mm) up to the crystal seat: the bright band inside the bezel in the photo

crystal.note: boxed domed crystal: straight wall to 9.0 mm, dome to 12.4 mm at the centre (12.6 mm listed thickness)

dial.note: flat dial to the dial edge; minute track, sub-dials, date and print in the photo map

applied.note: Roman numerals and bars: black plates from the photo outlines (Irsyad, 2026-11-10); ORIENT letters: raised plates with the photo on them

hands.note: faceted dauphine hour and minute with short tails, seconds needle with a round counterweight, sub-dial hands with a round head, ridge on the tip-tail axis: black (Irsyad, 2026-11-10, as the photo), seconds gold (photo)

crown.note: fluted crown on the 3 o'clock axis: 6.25 mm across, 3.0 mm from the case flank (photo)

strap.note: 21 mm brown croc leather, house curl (SUR419P1): bend at the lug tips, 7 mm radius, end = tip + 2.2 x radius; starts under the case. UVs from the photo's straight strap: the case edge on the centre line (trace strap_mm case_y) to photo_past_tip past the lug tip, folded back and forth

steel_polished.note: house polished steel: case, bezel, rehaut, lugs, crown

black_polished.note: black hands: dark lacquer, facets show by reflection

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass

review.subtitle: Polished steel, burgundy sunburst dial with day and 24-hour sub-dials, black hands and numerals, brown croc leather strap. Front relief GLB.
notes: Round 1, house method: case, bezel, lugs and crown are modelled in the house polished steel; hands, Roman numerals and bars are black, the seconds hand gold; the photo is used only for the dial print, the ORIENT letters and the leather strap.
Round 2: hour, minute and sub-dial hands, Roman numerals and bars changed from gold to black, as in the photo; the seconds hand stays gold.
Only a front photo was available: the domed crystal and bezel heights are estimated from the 12.6 mm listed thickness.
The buckle is left out. The strap curls under at both ends, like the other tracker watches.
